pages.experiments.append_never_overwrite: Every analysis is kept; nothing is overwritten.
pages.experiments.banner_bundle_failed: The context preview could not be built
pages.experiments.banner_confirm_failed: The output could not be confirmed
pages.experiments.banner_create_failed: The experiment could not be created
pages.experiments.banner_delete_failed: The experiment could not be deleted
pages.experiments.banner_diff_failed: The diff could not be read
pages.experiments.banner_file_failed: The file preview could not be opened
pages.experiments.banner_problem: The experiments module reported a problem
pages.experiments.banner_save_failed: The edit could not be saved
pages.experiments.btn_reveal_tooltip: Opens the containing folder read-only; nothing is written.
pages.experiments.cand_desc: First-level subdirectories of the experiment directory. Nothing is created until you pick one.
pages.experiments.cand_empty_reason: The experiment directory has no subdirectory, or it cannot be read right now.
pages.experiments.cand_title: Create a run from a subdirectory
pages.experiments.chart_caption: Bars show this snapshot's numeric metrics; they add no inference.
pages.experiments.compare_empty: A comparison needs at least two runs with metrics.
pages.experiments.context_desc: The exact deterministic bundle an analysis would send. Excluded files are listed with their reason.
pages.experiments.context_truncated_mess: The byte budget cut the bundle; narrow the rules or raise the limit to send more.
pages.experiments.create_defaults: The default rules keep model weights, caches, oversized and binary files out of the AI context. Pick a directory now or bind one later.
pages.experiments.create_desc: An experiment references a local folder. ResearchOS never changes the folder and never runs anything inside it.
pages.experiments.delete_message: “{title}” moves to the Recycle Bin. The directory, runs and analyses are kept.
pages.experiments.dir_dialog_desc: An absolute folder path outside the workspace. The binding is validated before it is stored; old analyses keep their original paths.
pages.experiments.disabled_reason: The composition root did not assemble the experiments services for this workspace, so no experiment can be read. Restart the application.
pages.experiments.disabled_title: The experiments module is not available
pages.experiments.edit_confirmed_hint: This output is confirmed. Saving marks it as edited by user; it stays confirmed.
pages.experiments.edit_draft_hint: A draft can be edited freely. The frozen snapshot copy never changes.
pages.experiments.edit_field_desc: Markdown. Saving writes the AI-service output, not the snapshot.
pages.experiments.empty_reason: Create an experiment to reference a local experiment folder and analyze it read-only.
pages.experiments.err_ai_unavailable: AI is not configured, so generation is unavailable. Scanning, metrics, Git and history still work.
pages.experiments.err_dir_guard: The path is inside the workspace or escapes with a symlink, so it is refused. Choose a folder outside the workspace.
pages.experiments.err_dir_unavailable: The experiment directory is missing or unavailable. Relocate it on this page.
pages.experiments.err_invalid_ai_output: The model returned an output that failed validation. Nothing was stored; try again.
pages.experiments.err_invalid_input: The input is invalid. Check the fields and try again.
pages.experiments.err_no_content: No file is eligible for the AI context. Check the scan rules and the directory.
pages.experiments.err_not_found: The experiment or run was not found in this project.
pages.experiments.err_read_only: This project is archived, so it is read-only.
pages.experiments.err_scan_limit: The scan reached a manifest limit. The preview shows what was scanned.
pages.experiments.err_snapshot_persist: The draft was saved but the snapshot could not be stored. Retry saving without regenerating.
pages.experiments.field_dir_desc: Optional. The folder is referenced, never copied or changed.
pages.experiments.field_purpose_hint: What the experiment tries to find out
pages.experiments.file_binary_note: This file is binary or an image; only its metadata is shown.
pages.experiments.file_excluded_reason: Kept out of the AI context: {reason}
pages.experiments.file_none_reason: Choose a file in the tree to see its metadata and its read-only content preview.
pages.experiments.file_not_in_context: This file is not part of the deterministic context bundle, so only its metadata is shown.
pages.experiments.file_sampled_note: Sampled preview: the analysis sends only this excerpt.
pages.experiments.git_diff_from_hint: Commit, branch or tag; empty means the working tree
pages.experiments.git_diff_hint: Leave both fields empty to compare the working tree. The read never writes the repository.
pages.experiments.git_diff_multi: The range touches several files; the patch is shown as text.
pages.experiments.git_diff_to_hint: Commit, branch or tag; empty means the working tree
pages.experiments.git_diff_truncated_mes: The diff is very large; only its beginning is shown.
pages.experiments.git_none_reason: The bound folder is not a Git repository (or it was not readable). Git is optional: everything else works.
pages.experiments.git_warning_message: This information was read at analysis time; the code may have changed since. ResearchOS never modifies the repository.
pages.experiments.history_append_note: Every analysis is kept; nothing is overwritten. Snapshots cannot be edited or deleted.
pages.experiments.history_empty_reason: Run an Outline or Results analysis. Every analysis is kept as a new snapshot; history is never overwritten.
pages.experiments.ideas_empty: No idea is linked to this experiment yet.
pages.experiments.link_desc: The link writes the validates relation from this experiment to the idea.
pages.experiments.link_fallback: The idea selector is not assembled in this workspace, so link by id.
pages.experiments.metrics_empty_reason: No metric was found in the scanned files. Nothing is inferred or invented.
pages.experiments.metrics_readonly_note: Read-only: the deterministic table above is the evidence.
pages.experiments.needs_project_reason: Open a project from the Projects page, then come back to reference its experiment folders.
pages.experiments.nonintrusive_message: ResearchOS reads the folder and never writes, renames or deletes anything inside it. It does not run the experiment or execute its code.
pages.experiments.notfound_reason: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another project.
pages.experiments.outline_desc: The outline is generated once and frozen into a snapshot. The live output can be edited and confirmed separately.
pages.experiments.outline_empty_reason: Generate an outline to get the seven sections with their sources and the points the model could not confirm.
pages.experiments.readonly_message: This project is archived. Reads and history browsing still work; every write is disabled.
pages.experiments.readonly_tooltip: This project is archived, so the action is disabled.
pages.experiments.recent_empty: No analysis has been run yet.
pages.experiments.results_empty_reason: Generate results to get the deterministic metric table and the model's interpretation of it.
pages.experiments.results_run_empty: No result metrics for this run yet.
pages.experiments.rules_bad_number: The thresholds must be positive whole numbers.
pages.experiments.rules_desc: One pattern per line. .git is always excluded and cannot be enabled.
pages.experiments.rules_git_forced: .git is always excluded and cannot be re-enabled.
pages.experiments.rules_summary: Include {include} · exclude {exclude} · file ≤ {file} · total ≤ {total} · up to {files} files · images in AI: {images}
pages.experiments.run_banner_message: The Results tab analyzes this run's directory (or the inherited one) and its parameters.
pages.experiments.run_dialog_desc: Parameters are hand-entered values. The directory defaults to the experiment's folder.
pages.experiments.run_params_hint: Parameters are stored as entered. Nothing is read from the files automatically.
pages.experiments.runs_empty_reason: A run is optional: scanning and analysis work on the experiment directory alone.
pages.experiments.scan_done: Scan finished: {files} files, {included} eligible for AI, {warnings} warnings.
pages.experiments.scan_nodir_reason: Bind a folder first; the preview reads it and writes nothing.
pages.experiments.scan_readonly_note: The preview is read-only and deterministic: same folder and rules give the same manifest.
pages.experiments.scan_truncated_message: The manifest reached a limit. What was scanned is still browsable; cancelled scans store nothing.
pages.experiments.snapshot_frozen: Frozen copy: edits and confirmations live in the AI output
pages.experiments.snapshot_no_ai: This snapshot carries no AI text.
pages.experiments.title: Experiments
pages.experiments.toast_ai_done: Analysis finished; a new snapshot was appended
pages.experiments.toast_create_failed: The experiment could not be created
pages.experiments.toast_delete_failed: The experiment could not be deleted
pages.experiments.toast_deleted: Experiment moved to the Recycle Bin
pages.experiments.toast_history_failed: The snapshot could not be read
pages.experiments.toast_reveal_failed: The folder could not be opened
pages.experiments.toast_run_failed: The run could not be created
pages.experiments.toast_saved_output: Output saved; the snapshot is unchanged
pages.experiments.toast_status_failed: The run status could not be saved
pages.experiments.toast_unlink_failed: The idea could not be unlinked
pages.experiments.tree_empty_reason: No file matches the filters. Clear the search or choose another kind.
pages.experiments.tree_paged: Showing the first {limit} entries. Narrow the filters to see the rest.
pages.experiments.confirm_desc: Once confirmed, this content becomes a research conclusion and is marked confirmed.
pages.experiments.confirm_hint: Confirmation applies to this output only; older versions remain in snapshot history.
pages.experiments.matrix_failed: Failed to build the comparison matrix
pages.experiments.matrix_no_diff_params: All runs use the same hyperparameters.
pages.experiments.matrix_no_notes: The project has no Research Note yet.
pages.experiments.matrix_insert_conflict: The note changed elsewhere; preview and insert again.
pages.experiments.params_duplicate: Two parameters use the same key.
